purpose: Controlled full-stack cache-entry comparison with unchanged production source, models, input audio and request settings.

turns.text: Actually, go to the office instead.

method: Four serial fresh rooms with one shared local stack, fixed cancel/repeat/repeat/cancel order; no retries or exclusions.
Each followup waits for substantive PCM belonging to the preceding newly finalized input and an unused speech handle; input count/timestamps/trigger boundaries are retained.
All three source WAVs are exact iteration16 bytes, including identical airport bytes in the first and third return turns. No rendering or input selection.

No production change. Only the LLM --prompt-cache-size value differs by declared arm (2/1/2); model bytes, seed, prompts/configuration, recorder and STT/TTS remain frozen. The inherited 655-test receipt is unchanged; no tests are rerun for these copied methods.

Navigation can use known destination directly or search first. Cached static search is valid and separately retained; every turn must freshly compute a route and start it. Three repeat starts use distinct computed routes and operation identities.

Preserve all physical attempted calls, cached reads, extra/missing/unrecognized transcripts, stale/error/duplicate events and effects. Separate exact allowed-plan regression from final semantic effects.
No source/configuration changes during live capture. Record room departure without deleting rooms, then own bounded stack cleanup and process-absence checks.

After all three timed stacks have exited and their owned PIDs are absent, transcribe every whole received stream once in separate supervised processes. Keep all failures and final facts separate from intentionally interrupted earlier replies.
Keep client packet identity and delayed attribution receipts. No synthetic participant delay; blank/nonagent data remains untrusted.
Unchanged experiment STT/AEC observer; diagnostic files flush after worker exit. No added accelerator synchronization.

Retain all plan_rejected events and semantic repairs from the unchanged navigation contract. Parsed plan receipts remain distinct from wire/parser requests and physical tool attempts. All ten effects and final speech criteria remain mandatory.
limitations: Reused synthetic development inputs and two repeated cases, not held-out FDB evaluation or human microphone/echo evidence.
Four fixed-order serial rooms and shared models do not support population accuracy, causal latency or concurrent-room capacity claims.
Client PCM receipt, speech-handle state and physical audible stop are different boundaries.
Planner optional lookup/cached read changes can alter physical attempt count; effects and allowable attempt chains are checked separately.
Default ICE/STUN may use network services although model inference stays local.
Private SDK sender identity shim is restricted to the reviewed installed source hash.
Initial/middle result speech is deliberately interrupted; full wording is assessed only for final replies.

Three fixed-order fresh stacks (2/1/2) are a bounded screening experiment, not independent hardware replicates; background load, OS caches and segmentation may differ. The nominal byte-budget flag is unenforced for seeded requests. More prefill and latency with one entry remain possible costs.
